title: LifePositionV0
description: Evaluator-only replayable life position for Polaris planner benchmarks. Never ingested by Enigma. Invariants instead of one exact move. See docs/architecture/polaris-search.md, docs/architecture/council.md, and ADR-011 / ADR-046 / ADR-047. Seats are earned when ranking_changed_by holds — not via a universal life score.

scenario.description: Optional link to an alex-v1 support-contract scenario id.

lenses.description: Functional Council seats that should materially contribute on this position. Internal ids only — not star names. A seat is earned when ablating it changes ply-0 or must_consider.

clock.description: Injected simulation clock for the position.

support_challenges.description: Evaluator-only tags aligned with support_contract.v0.json; never a person record.

must_consider.description: At least one of these legal move families should appear in the searched set or PV ply-0 candidates.

must_not_recommend.description: Ply-0 must not be one of these poor / illegal families.

legal_ceiling.description: Highest authority the position itself authorises; COMMIT still requires Assist.

ranking_changed_by.description: Lens ids that must change ply-0 (or must_consider) vs a baseline with those lenses ablated. Not a moral ranking of the person. Chair (navigation), herald, and chronicle are not ablation seats.

coverage_adequate.description: If false, ply-0 must not assume missing sources are empty (e.g. calendar adapter failed → incomplete picture, not a free afternoon).

unknowns_preserved.description: Fact ids that must remain unknown. Filling them fails the eval (Harbour / Goose).

if_polaris_defers.description: Optional (e.g. intention_preserved). Discarding a deferred intention fails.

notes.description: Author-side reminder. Not consumed by Enigma.
